details.report: Removed the Reviewer compatibility core at its owner seams. Deleted `ReviewerOutput`, `validateAcceptedReviewerDetails`, and the role-level validator wrapper; migrated package registry and role/runtime re-exports to `ReviewerIntent`, `validateReviewerIntent`, `validateRuntimeReviewerReceipt`, and `projectReviewerIntentToReceipt`. Regenerated tracked `dist/package-contracts` artifacts. Added compile/runtime regressions for absent legacy exports and authoritative completed/refused projection, plus installed-tarball coverage proving both thin intents become validated enriched V2 receipts. Preserved V2 projection, Recorder behavior, all other terminating tools, and workspace lifecycle. Verification passed: focused Reviewer/Recorder tests, typecheck, isolated-HOME full suite (329 pass, 5 pre-existing skips, 0 fail), installed package lifecycle, cold-install Recorder coverage, build, pack dry-run, and `git diff --check`. No findings were left unaddressed within this authorized class.
